scenes.title: “Happy to share I completed a certification.”
Copy this prompt
scenes.text: Turn this into an engaging LinkedIn post: [your achievement]. Start with a hook line, share 1 lesson I learned, keep it under 120 words, end with a question for readers.

scenes.text: I almost quit this course in week 2. Today I'm certified. The lesson? Consistency beats motivation. 20 minutes a day did what weekend marathons never could. What's one skill you're building this year?
